A group of explorers tried to reach Demona and died along the way. Cross the caves from Northport, open the entrance to the Maze of Lost Souls with a hidden lever and follow the safe path to the final room, at the gates of Demona. There you find a {item:Griffin Shield}, a {item:Dwarven Axe} and an {item:Obsidian Lance}.
A group of explorers tried to enter Demona and died on the way.
Enough food: the round trip is very long
recommended, to climb up the holes on the way back
Exploring the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls|Maze of Lost Souls} without a map is very dangerous: follow the images in this guide step by step.
Do not leave the path if you cannot handle {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
Go to the cave near Northport

The quest starts in a cave near **Northport**, a small village **north** of **Carlin**, in the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory}. Leave Carlin heading north to the cave, a little south of Northport.
Use the {item:Shovel} to open a hole at the marked spot and go into it. Follow the **blue** line on the map to the next hole.
Hole to open with the shovel
First part of the path (blue line)
Turn the lever in the underground forest

Keep following the blue line to a small forest inside the cave. At the red dot, behind the middle tree, there is a hole. Inside is a {item:Lever|lever} that you have to turn to the **right** to open the entrance to the Maze of Lost Souls. Next to it there is a sign: *“Greetings fellow brother! Turn the switch to the right and follow the blue sunshine to get to Demona. You know the rest of the way. Zhandramon”*.
Underground forest: the hole with the lever (red dot)
If the lever is already turned to the right, turn it to the left and then to the right again.
2. Cross the Maze of Lost Souls
Reach the entrance of the maze
Leave the hole and follow this path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls.
Path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls
Inside the maze, follow the map step by step. On the way you will face all the creatures on the danger list, from {creature:Rat|Rats} to {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}.
If you stray from the path you may run into {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.

In the final room there are 2 {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}, 2 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, 2 {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and 3 {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}. Kill them.
The final room with the rewards
The rewards are inside two {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|piles of bones} and a corpse. Open all three and pick up the {item:Griffin Shield}, the {item:Dwarven Axe} and the {item:Obsidian Lance}.
Leave the Maze of Lost Souls
You have to leave the Maze of Lost Souls. Follow the path on this map: there are other exits, but this one is the safest and shortest.
Exit path from the Maze of Lost Souls
If you are level 60+, since you are at the gates of Demona, you can take the chance to do the {wiki:Double SD Quest|Double SD Quest}.

After leaving the maze, go back **the same way you came in**: pass through the lever area and the holes again (climb up with the {item:Rope} in the holes you went down) until you are back on the surface, south of Northport. From there walk back **south** to **Carlin**.
Alternative for level 60+: leave through Demona

If you are level 60+ and pass the **Gate of Expertise**, you can also leave the area by crossing {wiki:Demona|Demona}, along the path in this image. You will meet many of the monsters of the area, such as {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}; it is only worth it if you can handle Demona.
